description: Discover New Startups Through Video DemoBook is a dedicated platform for marketing and product discovery that focuses on the power of visual storytelling. By prioritizing launch demos over static descriptions, the platform allows users to see exactly how new software products function in real-time. This approach follows the philosophy of showing rather than just telling, providing a clearer picture of a startup's value proposition.
